name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.76 / build 77 updates the supplied SMAPE and MAPE forms, form-only PDF exports and flexible inline remarks. Saved vital signs are read-only for patients; authorized clinic staff can save versioned history corrections and notify the owning patient. Legacy SMPE references display as SMAPE without changing saved database keys. Existing booking, chat and medical-form scrolling are retained. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation, native on-device interaction and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
